params.prompt: Full-body character design: the captain of the forge town's night watch, a tall, lean woman with a calm, watchful face and a dark braid over one shoulder. She wears a long quilted coat of deep slate blue with brass buttons, a leather belt, tall boots and a plain iron kettle-hat helmet with a wide brim. On her left arm is a round shield made from a cast-iron stove door, with a brass hinge strap across it and a small glowing orange grille at its centre. In her right hand she holds a broad single-edged sword whose cutting edge glows orange like iron fresh from the forge, with a simple hooked crossguard. Front view, standing upright, feet apart, shield arm and sword arm held a little away from the body, sword pointing down. Chunky stylised proportions, clean readable shapes, hand-painted look, an original character for a stylised 3D video game set in a mountain forge town. Soft even studio lighting, plain light grey background, no text, no cast shadows.
